---
description: "Use when the user asks for CV corrections, Kirby changes, wording updates, section edits, or direct modifications to cv.html."
applyTo: "cv.html,style.css,script.js,assets/**"
---
# CV Direct Edit Mode

- Apply requested changes directly in the project files instead of stopping at analysis.
- Prioritize `cv.html` for content/structure changes, then `style.css` and `script.js` when styling or behavior is requested.
- Keep edits minimal and aligned with the existing CV layout and writing style.
- If the request is ambiguous, make the safest reasonable interpretation and state exactly what was changed.
- After editing, run the existing verification command(s) used in this repository when relevant.
